sources_added.title: Virtual Bass System With Fuzzy Separation of Tones and Transients
sources_added.bounded_conclusion: Evidence for virtual-bass enhancement on severely bandwidth-limited playback; not evidence for a universal full-range rock-bass distortion rule.

blockers: author reports tonal path too expensive for feasible real-time use

knowledge_cards_added.claim: Virtual bass is a constrained-playback intervention, not recovered low-frequency energy or a universal mix rule.
The proposed method averaged 47.0 while the full-band reference averaged 98.6; relative anchor improvement is not parity with intact bass.
Per-stimulus tuning and varying results block transfer of one universal preset.
The public method is noncausal and approximately 150 ms delayed according to the author; it is not Wing/live-ready.
Public source availability alone does not establish exact reproduction, licence permission or deployability.
